race.comment: I LOVE YA MONEY (6) strode forward early from his wide draw last start over 1400m at this track then fought on gamely to finish second. That was the fourth top-three finish from as many starts this time in and this is no tougher than the past couple, so he'll be thereabouts again. BOSUN (1) has scored at his last two starts, most recently by 3/4 of a length over 1300m at this track as favourite. That continued the very strong form this campaign, with two wins from three starts. Sure to go well again. JAZALOT (2) turned in an eye-catching run last start over 1400m at this track, winding up hard from well back on straightening to finish a close second. Jumps up in weight here, but that could be offset by the gun draw. GET OUT MICK (8) is struggling to break through, but he's been placed at five of his past seven starts and is a must for quaddies and exotics. RAZMAS (5) turned in one of his better first-up runs last start when fourth, beaten 2.5 lengths, so he could springboard off that.
